title: Why, and Because
label: ch:ml-kaaranam
canDo: I can ask why something is so, and give a reason in speech or in writing.

payoff.summary: From cold: the question word and the two ways to answer it, which of them belongs in speech, and the word from chapter two that the question is built on.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. It closes both halves of a two-way gap: until now cause could neither be asked about nor supplied.
